title: Val Town
description: A social website to write and run serverless TypeScript. Write small functions ('vals'), schedule recurring crons, deploy instant webhooks, and share state.
features: Write TypeScript in your browser and execute it instantly in an isolated runtime
Scheduled cron jobs configured with natural language intervals or standard cron syntax
Instant HTTP webhooks and email triggers out of the box
Built-in SQLite database and key-value blob storage attached to every account
Forkable public vals with NPM package importing straight from ESM
pros: Zero git repository setup, zero deployment scripts, zero AWS credentials
Unbeatable developer speed for scrapers, bots, and small glue microservices
Active creative community sharing useful automation scripts
cons: Not intended for massive monolithic codebases or heavy binary dependencies
Execution timeout limits on free tier jobs
targetAudience: Developers building internal tools, alerting bots, scheduled scrapers, and quick APIs.
